english.title: Possess salmon/trout/instrument/explosives/poison to fish unlawfully for salmon in Tweed district
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) obtained possession of

(A)_[salmon]_
(B)_[trout]_
(C)_[an instrument, namely **(..SPECIFY INSTRUMENT..),]_
(D)_[explosives, namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVES..),]_
(E)_[a poison or noxious substance, namely **(..SPECIFY SUBSTANCE..),]_

(F)_[as the result]_
(G)_[for the purpose]_

of fishing for or taking salmon in

(H)_[inland waters in the Tweed district, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), except by rod and line or net and coble]_
(I)_[waters other than inland waters in the Tweed district, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), except by rod and line, net and coble or bag net, fly net or other stake net]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 22 and 30 of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
obtained possession of salmon, trout, an instrument, explosives, poison or noxious substance,
as the result or for the purpose
of fishing for or taking salmon in inland waters in the Tweed district except by rod and line or net and coble OR
waters other than inland waters in the Tweed district,except by rod and line, net and coble or bag net, fly net or other stake net
